component.name: Shiftray
component.summary: Modes, fans and GPU for ASUS laptops

description.p: Shiftray is a tray app for ASUS laptops. It is a window for asusctl (asusd) and Cardwire, which do the hardware work, and its windows follow the design of G-Helper. It is unofficial and not affiliated with ASUS or the G-Helper project.

ul.li: Silent, Balanced, Turbo and custom performance modes, remembered per power source
Fan curves for CPU and GPU, CPU power limits and Dynamic Boost
GPU modes: Eco, Standard, Ultimate and Optimized
Screen refresh rate, keyboard lighting and battery charge limit
Actions for Fn keys and the Armoury key
BIOS, driver and firmware updates in one window

description.p: It needs asusctl (asusd) and Cardwire; a Setup window installs what the laptop still needs. It runs on KDE Plasma and GNOME.

screenshot.caption: The main window in a dark and a light theme
Situations: one-click sets of mode, GPU, screen and keyboard light

description.p: A game can switch the performance mode (off by default): one mode for the charger, one for battery. The previous mode comes back when the last game quits.
GNOME support: Setup installs and enables the AppIndicator extension for the tray icon, and notifications, logout and the keyboard light timeout use GNOME's own mechanisms.
The NVIDIA GPU no longer stays awake because of the app, and notification buttons now show up.
